name: 11714 · Bethpage, NY
findings: ZIP 11714 (Bethpage) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11714 (Bethpage) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11714 (Bethpage) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.
